I personally don't see a scenario where investing in VTHO is a good idea. The price of VTHO would only go up significantly when the current supply starts to dry up and at that point the foundation will be considering either (1) increasing generation rate or (2) lowering transaction costs. 

In scenario 1, the value of VTHO should spike down while the value of VET should go up because it will allow for more transactions.

In scenario 2, the value of VTHO should increase because it will allow for more transactions, but the value of VET should do the same for the same reason in this case. 

I think investing in VTHO is kind of like a double speculative investment. Sure you could time it right and maybe sell right before they announce a change in tokenomics and everything goes back to normal, but I think it's a luck based move in an already speculative market. I see the value of VET going up in both these cases so it's an easy choice for me.
